Title: ComponentOptions - UI Component Configuration
Summary: Configuration class for UI components, particularly settings page components. Tracks registered settings components with section grouping and ordering.
Content:
## ComponentOptions

**Namespace**: `Cyrena.Options`
**Assembly**: `Cyrena.Components.Core`

### Purpose
Configuration class for UI components, particularly settings pages. Tracks which Blazor components should render as settings tabs/panels, with support for section grouping and display ordering.

### Class Definition

```csharp
public class ComponentOptions
{
    public ComponentOptions()
    {
        SettingsComponents = new List<ComponentMetaData>();
    }

    internal List<ComponentMetaData> SettingsComponents { get; set; }

    public ComponentMetaData[] GetSettingsComponents()
    {
        return SettingsComponents.ToArray();
    }
}
```

### Properties

| Property | Type | Access | Description |
|----------|------|--------|-------------|
| `SettingsComponents` | `List<ComponentMetaData>` | `internal` | Internal collection of registered settings components |

### Methods

#### `GetSettingsComponents()`
```csharp
public ComponentMetaData[] GetSettingsComponents();
```
Returns all registered settings components as an array. Used by the settings UI to render tabs/panels.

public record ComponentMetaData(Type Component, string? Section, int Order);

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `Component` | `Type` | The Blazor component type to render |

### Methods

#### `AddSettingsComponent<TComponent>()` [Obsolete]
```csharp
[Obsolete("Use new section mapping API")]
public static void AddSettingsComponent<TComponent>(this ComponentOptions options)
    where TComponent : ComponentBase;
```
Registers a component with no section and order 0. **Obsolete** — use the section overloads instead.

#### `AddSettingsComponent<TComponent>(string section)`
```csharp
public static void AddSettingsComponent<TComponent>(this ComponentOptions options, string section);
```
Registers a component under the specified section with order 0.

#### `AddSettingsComponent<TComponent>(string section, int order)`
```csharp
public static void AddSettingsComponent<TComponent>(this ComponentOptions options, string section, int order);
```
Registers a component under the specified section with the given display order.

**Duplicate prevention**: Each overload checks `!options.SettingsComponents.Any(x => x.Component == typeof(TComponent))` before adding.

### Registration via CyrenaBuilder
Use `CyrenaBuilderExtensions` for application-level registration:
```csharp
builder.AddSettingsComponent<MySettingsComponent>("General", 1);
```

This delegates to `ComponentOptions.AddSettingsComponent` after resolving the `ComponentOptions` feature option.
